title: LazynessIBCME
description: This mod adds the ability to convert blocks such as logs and wood into their respective varients, dirt into mud, concrete powder into concrete and making unwaxing copper blocks easier.
body:
# 🛠️ LazynessIBCME: Simple Block Conversions!

Stop wasting time and inventory space on basic resource swaps! LazynessIBCME is a quality-of-life mod, making several annoying block conversions quick and easy using vanilla tools.
## What it Does:

    Stonecutter Wood Prep: Convert Logs and Wood into all their different  stripped variants right on the Stonecutter.

    Cauldron Mud and concrete: Turn dirt into mud  as well as concrete powder into concrete easily using a cauldron.

    Grindstone Copper Cleanup: Quickly unwax any copper block with the grindstone if you change your mind!

It's all about making your building process faster and less tedious. Enjoy the laziness!
